answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the horizon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The mirror is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the mesa.
